certificate.description: Path to certificate (in PEM format without the `file://` prefix)

repository.description: S/MIME certificate repository service. This service shall implement the `Symfony\Component\Mailer\EventListener\SmimeCertificateRepositoryInterface`.

certificates.description: Recipient S/MIME certificates, as a map of email address to certificate file path. Cannot be used together with "repository".

on_missing_certificate.description: Default behavior when a recipient has no S/MIME certificate: "send_unencrypted" (send the message unencrypted, deprecated since 8.2), "fail" (throw an exception), "encrypt" (encrypt for the recipients that have a certificate, the others receive an unreadable message), "skip" (encrypt for the recipients that have a certificate and drop the others from the envelope; note that "framework.mailer.envelope.recipients" is applied afterwards and overrides that list). Can be overridden per message by setting the "X-SMime-Encrypt" header to one of these values.

encrypt_for_sender.description: Also encrypt for the sender, when a certificate is available for its address, so that the sender can read the messages it sent.

cipher.description: A set of algorithms used to encrypt the message

secret_key.description: Path to the secret key (ASCII armored format without the `file://` prefix)

public_key.description: Path to the public key (ASCII armored format without the `file://` prefix)

digest_algorithm.description: The digest algorithm used to sign the message

repository.description: Service or class implementing `Symfony\Component\Mailer\EventListener\PgpPublicKeyRepositoryInterface` to provide recipient PGP public keys.

keys.description: Recipient PGP public keys, as a map of email address to public key file path. Cannot be used together with "repository".

cipher_algorithm.description: The cipher algorithm used to encrypt the message

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the GPG process (null for no timeout)

hide_recipients.description: Hide every recipient's key ID in the encrypted message (gpg --hidden-recipient). Recipients listed in the Bcc header are always hidden regardless of this option; set it to true to also hide To and Cc recipients.

on_missing_key.description: Default behavior when a recipient has no PGP public key: "fail" (throw an exception), "encrypt" (encrypt for the recipients that have a key, the others receive an unreadable message), "skip" (encrypt for the recipients that have a key and drop the others from the envelope; note that "framework.mailer.envelope.recipients" is applied afterwards and overrides that list). The message is never sent unencrypted. Can be overridden per message by setting the "X-Pgp-Encrypt" header to one of these values.

encrypt_for_sender.description: Also encrypt for the sender, when a public key is available for its address, so that the sender can read the messages it sent.

message_bus.description: The message bus to use. Defaults to the default bus if the Messenger component is installed.

lock_factory.description: The service ID of the lock factory to use with the RateLimiterBuilder.

cache_pool.description: The cache pool to use with RateLimiterBuilder.

storage_service.description: The service ID of a custom storage implementation, this precedes any configured "cache_pool".

lock_factory.description: The service ID of the lock factory used by this limiter (or null to disable locking).

cache_pool.description: The cache pool to use for storing the current limiter state.

storage_service.description: The service ID of a custom storage implementation, this precedes any configured "cache_pool".

policy.description: The algorithm to be used by this limiter.

key.description: The key to pass to this limiter, instead of the one passed to the compound limiter's create() method.

limiters.description: The limiters to use when using the "compound" policy.

limit.description: The maximum allowed hits in a fixed interval or burst.

interval.description: Configures the fixed interval if "policy" is set to "fixed_window" or "sliding_window". The value must be a number followed by "second", "minute", "hour", "day", "week" or "month" (or their plural equivalent).
Configures the rate interval. The value must be a number followed by "second", "minute", "hour", "day", "week" or "month" (or their plural equivalent).

amount.description: Amount of tokens to add each interval.

rate.description: Configures the fill rate if "policy" is set to "token_bucket".

anchor_at.description: Aligns the "fixed_window" policy to a calendar (e.g. "2024-01-05 00:00:00 UTC" combined with `interval: 1 month` resets the counter on the 5th of each month). UTC if not specified.

uuid47_secret.description: A high-entropy secret used by the "uuid47_transformer" service. Defaults to "kernel.secret".

default_action.description: Defines how the sanitizer must behave by default.

allow_static_elements.description: Allows all static elements and attributes from the W3C Sanitizer API standard.

allow_elements.description: Configures the elements that the sanitizer should retain from the input. The element name is the key, the value is either a list of allowed attributes for this element or "*" to allow the default set of attributes (https://wicg.github.io/sanitizer-api/#default-configuration).

block_elements.description: Configures elements as blocked. Blocked elements are elements the sanitizer should remove from the input, but retain their children.

drop_elements.description: Configures elements as dropped. Dropped elements are elements the sanitizer should remove from the input, including their children.

allow_attributes.description: Configures attributes as allowed. Allowed attributes are attributes the sanitizer should retain from the input.

drop_attributes.description: Configures attributes as dropped. Dropped attributes are attributes the sanitizer should remove from the input.

force_attributes.description: Forcefully set the values of certain attributes on certain elements.

force_https_urls.description: Transforms URLs using the HTTP scheme to use the HTTPS scheme instead.

allowed_link_schemes.description: Allows only a given list of schemes to be used in links href attributes.

allowed_link_hosts.description: Allows only a given list of hosts to be used in links href attributes.

allow_relative_links.description: Allows relative URLs to be used in links href attributes.

allowed_media_schemes.description: Allows only a given list of schemes to be used in media source attributes (img, audio, video, ...).

allowed_media_hosts.description: Allows only a given list of hosts to be used in media source attributes (img, audio, video, ...).

allow_relative_medias.description: Allows relative URLs to be used in media source attributes (img, audio, video, ...).

max_input_length.description: The maximum length allowed for the sanitized input.

http_client.description: The HTTP client to use to send webhooks.

subnets.description: Subnets in CIDR notation to consider private. Defaults to the standard private subnets.

allow_list.description: IPs or subnets in CIDR notation to send to even when they match the private subnets.

no_private_network.description: Refuse to send webhooks to URLs that resolve to a private network.

signature_format.description: The signature scheme to emit and to require: "legacy" (default) for Symfony's historical "<algo>=<hex>" over the event name, the id and the body; "standard" for the Standard Webhooks "v1,<base64>" over the id, the timestamp and the body, which moves the event name from the "Webhook-Event" header to the payload's "type" key; "transitional" for both at once, during a migration.

timestamp_tolerance.description: How far, in seconds, an incoming Standard Webhooks timestamp may be from the current time before the request is rejected as a replay. Set to 0 to accept any timestamp. Legacy signatures carry no timestamp and are never bounded.

secret.description: The secret used to verify incoming request signatures. It must be set in production: with an empty value, requests from any sender are accepted.

include_null_properties.description: Encode the properties with null value

channels.description: List of additional channels to create. The "app" channel is already created by default. Channels are also automatically created for services using the "monolog.logger" DI tag with a custom channel attribute.

php_binary.description: PHP binary used to spawn task subprocesses. null = resolve at runtime (recommended).

lock_runner.description: Global lock on scheduler:run itself. false = concurrent ticks allowed (per-task `lock` handles overlap).

lock.description: Per-task anti-overlap lock (skips this task if a previous run is still active).

default_path.description: The default path used to load templates.

file_name_pattern.description: Pattern of file name used for cache warmer and linter.

timezone.description: The timezone used when formatting dates, when set to null, the timezone returned by date_default_timezone_get() is used.

date.description: The default format options used by the date filter.

number_format.description: The default format options for the number_format filter.
